summary: Customer service platform organized around people rather than tickets, for enterprise brands.
access_note: No self-serve signup seen (Get a demo); API tokens are created by an admin for a user with the API User permission, used as HTTP Basic.
blocker_note: Only existing Gladly customers (enterprise sales) have an organization and tokens; no trial or sandbox signup found.
notes: MCP none rests on a third-party report card (Aug 2026); StackOne and Truto offer hosted MCP wrappers but those are not vendor servers. A per-org sandbox at gladly.qa is mentioned by the same third-party page, availability to non-customers not confirmed.

evidence.quote: Gladly API uses token-based Basic Authentication .
To create and use an API token, your user must have the API User permission.
No official or community MCP server was found for Gladly.
